schemas.name: attempts
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE attempts (
                    operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(operation_id),
                    attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_no > 0),
                    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('started','response','uncertain')),
                    exposure_units INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(exposure_units >= 0),
                    response_status INTEGER,
                    raw_response BLOB,
                    started_at REAL NOT NULL,
                    completed_at REAL,
                    error TEXT,
                    PRIMARY KEY(operation_id, attempt_no)
                )

schemas.name: config
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE config (
                    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
                    exposure_cap INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(exposure_cap >= 0),
                    call_cap INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(call_cap >= 0)
                )

schemas.name: operations
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE operations (
                    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    branch TEXT NOT NULL,
                    request BLOB NOT NULL,
                    exposure_per_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(exposure_per_attempt >= 0),
                    retry_bound INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(retry_bound IN (0,1)),
                    retry_429_authorized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(retry_429_authorized IN (0,1)),
                    retry_max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    retry_base_backoff REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.25,
                    retry_max_backoff REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 8.0,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ready','started','succeeded','failed','uncertain')),
                    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts >= 0),
                    response_status INTEGER,
                    raw_response BLOB,
                    parse_status TEXT,
                    parsed_json TEXT,
                    parse_error TEXT,
                    error TEXT
                )

schemas.name: vertex_attempts
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE vertex_attempts (
                    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    logical_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vertex_calls(logical_id),
                    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('count','generation')),
                    attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_no IN (0,1)),
                    endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                    reserved_micro_usd INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    settled_micro_usd INTEGER,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared',
                    http_status INTEGER, response_sha256 TEXT, response_bytes INTEGER,
                    observed_model TEXT, usage_json TEXT, finish_reason TEXT,
                    count_tokens INTEGER,
                    UNIQUE(logical_id,kind,attempt_no)
                )

schemas.name: vertex_calls
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE vertex_calls (
                    logical_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    stage TEXT NOT NULL, role_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                    request BLOB NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared', error TEXT
                )

schemas.name: vertex_run
schemas.sql:
CREATE TABLE vertex_run (
                    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
                    contract BLOB NOT NULL, halted TEXT
                )
